title: Law to create one online database for towed vehicles
summary: This bill would require the Department of Finance and other designated city agencies to build a single online database where vehicle owners can look up any vehicle towed from public or private property by the city or a licensed tow operator. Owners could also opt in to text or email alerts when their vehicle appears in the database. Towing entities would have to post information within two hours of a tow, and the bill repeals the older rule requiring separate notice to local police precincts.
